prompt: Write exactly one concise, information-dense caption (12–30 words) as a single sentence describing only visually verifiable details. Do not infer emotions, intentions, or activity labels unless directly supported by visible props. Use this slot order and include only items you can see: [count] [primary subject] [specific visible action/pose] on/in [surface] wearing [distinct clothing/markings] holding/near [visible prop] background: [distinct anchor] lighting: [color/direction]; include one camera-relative spatial relation (e.g., foreground, left/right, behind). If a required slot is not visible, state "no [slot] visible" (e.g., "no ball visible") or use "about N"/"at least N" if uncertain. Use concrete tokens (colors, numbers, object types, clothing parts); avoid subjective/adjectival judgments (e.g., excited, skillful, beautiful). Produce exactly one sentence caption and nothing else.
